content_sections.heading: About NIPER-Raebareli
content_sections.text: NIPER-Raebareli is the National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research. The notice carries the address of its Department of Biotechnology at Bijnor-Sisendi Road, Sarojini Nagar, Near CRPF Base Camp, Lucknow (UP) - 226002. The post sits in a research project led by Principal Investigator Dr. Saurabh Awasthi, Assistant Professor, Department of Biotechnology. The Co-PI is Dr. Rahul Shukla, Assistant Professor, Department of Pharmaceutics. The position is purely temporary.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from Indian citizens who are residents of Uttar Pradesh. Candidates must meet the prescribed CSTUP eligibility criteria. Desirable skills: research experience in molecular biology, biochemistry, aptamers, protein aggregation, fluorescence spectroscopy, cell-based or biochemical assays, or related techniques. Age limit: 28 years as on 01 April 2026. Any relaxation shall be governed by applicable CSTUP guidelines. The notice does not list relaxations by category. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility.

rows.essential_qualification: M.Sc. / M.Sc. (Agriculture) / M.Pharm. / M.V.Sc. / B.E. / B.Tech. or equivalent degree in a relevant discipline, with first class in both graduation and postgraduation examinations, as applicable under CSTUP guidelines

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The monthly fellowship is ₹25,000 (consolidated) for the first two years and ₹28,000 (consolidated) for the third year, as per the sanctioned project. The tenure is initially one year. It is extendable based on satisfactory performance, availability of funds and the sanctioned project duration (three years). The appointment does not confer any claim to regular employment or continuation in another project.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIPER Raebareli Junior Research Assistant (JRA)
content_sections.text: Fill in and sign the application form in the prescribed format. The proforma is on page 2 of the notice and asks for name, father's name, gender, date of birth, category (UR/OBC/SC/ST), correspondence address, phone number, email, educational details (10th, 12th, Bachelors, Masters) and other relevant information, with a photo. Attach an updated CV, self-attested mark sheets/certificates, proof of date of birth, proof of Uttar Pradesh domicile/residence, and relevant supporting documents. Submit the application to the Principal Investigator, Dr. Saurabh Awasthi, Department of Biotechnology, NIPER-Raebareli, Lucknow. Applications may be submitted by email to [email protected] , with the subject "Application for JRA-CSTUP Project 7701". Applications must be submitted by 22.11.2026. Postal address printed in the notice: Dr. Saurabh Awasthi, Principal Investigator, Department of Biotechnology, National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research (NIPER-Raebareli), Bijnor-Sisendi Road, Sarojini Nagar, Near CRPF Base Camp, Lucknow (UP) - 226002.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisting will be based on qualifications, academic record and suitability for the project. Shortlisted candidates will be informed of the interview arrangements by email. They must produce original documents for verification. The interview is from 11 am onwards on 26.11.2026 at NIPER Raebareli transit campus, in Lucknow.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applicants must be Indian citizens resident in Uttar Pradesh, and the application must include proof of Uttar Pradesh domicile/residence. Candidates must meet the prescribed CSTUP eligibility criteria. No TA/DA will be paid. Original documents must be produced for verification by shortlisted candidates. Recruitment will be governed by CSTUP R&D guidelines and applicable NIPER-Raebareli rules. The position is purely temporary and gives no claim to regular employment.
